title: Scope the Analytics tab to one role, with every unscopable figure withheld
deviations_from_card: Followed the critic revision: store scoped only via the entry_id join (cohort, momentum, kindCounts -> automation/offers/automationRoi, holdRow, hiresClosedInWindow, prior slice); bySource, per-channel decision median, channel spend (+ spend-only rows, CPA/CPH), blended costPerHireCzk, computeCost.costPerHireUsd and koDeclined are withheld by name in payload.jobScope.withheld (placeholders null/[]/0). byJob keyed by job id with koDeclined:number|null (null when a title is shared by >1 req or under a role scope). Write-set growth: analyticsFunnelCsv.ts (+2 lines: RoleCsvRow.koDeclined widened to number|null, exported as the em dash) forced by the byJob type change; analyticsRenderMap.test.ts STAGED_FIELDS jobId entry cleared (self-clearing guard, as the critic flagged). The withheld vocabulary (JOB_SCOPE_WITHHELD) lives in db/analytics.ts; analyticsJobScope.ts type-imports it. The pure analyticsJobScope module was drafted before its tests and moved aside to observe them red.
notes: Acceptance 7 of 7 (13 node:test cases, all red before). Catalog keys (en/cs/de/fr, 25 lines each at the end of top-level `analytics`) landed alone under the lock in a7ff2b231; the doc section in 5524c449b + 807b04770. unit: 10065/10066 — the one failure is a FLAKE in an unrelated spawn/process-tree test ('an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'), passed on re-run. test:perf red on 12 app/api route graphs (hire-from-need, analyze, jds/generate, devcase/*, …) by 1-6 KB: `check-budget.mjs --explain` shows NONE of those graphs contains any analytics file I touched (their growth is core.ts/pipeline.ts, e.g. 8cfc592df db-org-users-channels); the numbers were identical before and after I trimmed ~7 KB from my own store diff, so the overage is a sibling's, not raised by me. tsc whole-tree only reports errors under untracked kpi-sim/ (foreign). For r05 analytics-metrics: pipelineAnalytics under a jobId now returns jobScope and withholds the named figures; byJob rows carry jobId and koDeclined may be null.
